primary.endpoint: Mean original-rule success fraction at g16..33 across four packets per block, then across21 blocks.
primary.criterion: Single paired acquisition-block contrast: guard minus matched-random under independent noise. Support iff one-sided95% t lower limit>0 with nondegenerate block variance; contradiction iff nondegenerate one-sided95% upper<=0; otherwise unresolved. This is a development screen, not new-founder confirmation or equivalence.
primary.inference: 21 source acquisition blocks are the uncertainty unit. Quota coupling stays within each block; packets, time points and arms are not independent replicates. Approximate paired t intervals; conditional exposed-panel/fresh-future estimand.

allocation.rule: At each g15..32, count K current successful guard reads among the four packets in this block and noise regime. Guard promotes precisely those successful candidates. The matched-random arm promotes a uniform K-subset of its own four candidates, regardless of its own current results. Ordinary arm always promotes; protected arm never promotes. g33 outgoing candidates are not inherited.
allocation.seed: First16 SHA256 bytes, little-endian, of compact JSON [namespace,stage,block,0,generation,promotion_subset]. PCG64 permutation of [0,1,2,3], choose firstK. Regime and injury are excluded so both noise regimes share subset order. Separate from native forcing streams.
allocation.schedule: All current reads precede the count. No future observations, donor outcomes from other blocks or later target decisions can enter the current action. Guard never depends on the matched-random arm.
allocation.apparatus: Matched-random is a coupled diagnostic comparator supplied with the guard group contemporaneous aggregate K. It has no per-packet success input, but is not a standalone feedback-free scheduler. Both own reads and the donor guard reads are retained in total computation accounting.
allocation.matching: Exactly equal rewrite counts per block, noise regime and generation; no claim of equal counts per packet or historical stratum.

secondary: Descriptive all-policy endpoints, both cue-noise regimes, both g14 historical classes, all paired policy contrasts, and shared pre-action g15 expression strata. Keep terminal, uninterrupted and recovery outcomes separate. First recovery times of guard and protected copy coincide by construction before any successful rewrite; that identity is not additional evidence.
forcing: PCG64 seed from first16 SHA256 bytes, little-endian, of compact JSON [namespace,stage,*key,0,generation,purpose,channel]. Channel injury gives a uniform permutation of the244 non-port cells; take first24. Channel forcing gives2049x2x16x16 normal draws. Exclude injury count, policy and noise regime from seed. Matched copies cue0 birth/noise to cue1; independent keeps both. All policies share forcing and evolve their own packets.
qualification: Seven concurrent disposable full-horizon units, both noise regimes and four policies, full independent flat-reader propagation of all four packets and all four policies at every read. All donor counts, subset draws, decisions, forcing and lineage updates independently verified. Timing measured before development release. No new acquisition required; source is committed original g14 packets from21 exposed blocks.
exposure: All48 source blocks and prior outcomes were exposed. The21-block subset uses only a declared hash of IDs. New forcing and allocation streams are fresh. Sample chosen for full coupled audit and one-hour feasibility, with no claimed power for an unmeasured comparator. New-source confirmation requires a separate study.
